analyses.statisticalComment: P-value is stratified by the randomization stratification factors and is 1-sided, with a 0.10 threshold for significance.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: PFS is defined as the number of months from the date of randomization to the earlier of progressive disease (PD) or death due to any cause.

groups.description: Exemestane (Aromasin®) 25 mg tablets orally once daily plus a placebo-matching entinostat tablet orally once per week on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day treatment cycle until development of progressive disease (PD) or unacceptable toxicity or closure of the study by the Sponsor, whichever occurred first.
groups.title: Exemestane 25 mg + Placebo

groups.description: Exemestane (Aromasin®) 25 mg tablets orally once daily plus an entinostat 5 mg tablet orally once per week on Days 1, 8, 15 and 22 of each 28-day treatment cycle until development of progressive disease (PD) or unacceptable toxicity or closure of the study by the Sponsor, whichever occurred first.
groups.title: Exemestane 25 mg + Entinostat 5 mg

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Full Analysis Set included all randomized participants.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: From date of randomization to discontinuation due to disease progression or death up to primary completion date (Median follow-up 6 months)
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Progression-free Survival (PFS)
